case_summary: Coastal Energy LLC appeals a decision that Nationwide Permit 12 did not cover their dredging activities for their LNG terminal, while also challenging whether the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission's (FERC) Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) adequately addressed new climate change studies.
key_legal_issues: Whether Nationwide Permit 12 covers Coastal Energy LLC's dredging activities for their LNG terminal.
Whether the plain text of Nationwide Permit 12 limits its coverage to activities 'incidental' to utility line construction.
Whether the district court erred in reading an implied acreage cap into Nationwide Permit 12.
Whether the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission's EIS satisfies the requirements of the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA).
Whether the FERC was required to supplement the EIS based on new climate change studies.

predictions.rationale: Judges will to focus on statutory language and intent, particularly the term 'incidental' as it applies to NWP 12.
